Follow an investment in NVIDIA shares over a chosen period

investment_path.Rd

Keeps the trading days between start and end, then calculates what an amount invested at the first closing price in that period would be worth on each day, and how far it had fallen from its highest value so far.

Usage

investment_path(prices, start, end, amount = 1000)

Arguments

prices

A data frame of daily prices with date and close columns, such as nvda.

start, end

First and last dates of the period, as Date objects or "YYYY-MM-DD" strings.

amount

Amount invested at the first closing price, in US dollars.

Value

The rows of prices within the period, with three added columns: value (worth of the investment that day), gain_pct (percentage gain or loss since the start) and drawdown_pct (percentage fall from the highest closing price so far in the period; 0 at a new high). Returns zero rows when the period contains no trading days.

Examples

# $1,000 invested at the start of 2020
path <- investment_path(nvda, "2020-01-01", "2026-09-21", amount = 1000)
tail(path, 1)
#>            date   open  high    low  close    volume daily_return_pct   sma_20
#> 1688 2026-09-21 222.94 228.5 221.56 227.38 109806100         2.299006 219.3635
#>        sma_50 volatility_20_pct    value gain_pct drawdown_pct
#> 1688 214.4001          46.18114 38169.34 3716.934    -3.325811

# The largest fall from a peak during 2022
min(investment_path(nvda, "2022-01-01", "2022-12-31")$drawdown_pct)
#> [1] -62.70168
